producer_report.summary: The producer brief now has a section, `## How the verifier checks each criterion`, with one hint line per accepted criterion. A content criterion gets a named file or diff line. A behavior criterion gets a command that ran. A sweep criterion ('every mention', 'no longer appears') adds a repo-wide search with zero remaining hits. A rewrapped-prose criterion adds a line-width check. A criterion that only Athena's fmt, clippy and test checks can show gets the 'left to Athena's checks' hint. The classifier `is_athena_check_criterion` moved from send_back.rs into briefs.rs, so the brief and the send-back use one definition. A passing producer attempt now stores `self-check passed; redacted report: <json>` as its invocation detail, matching the failing path. D191 in docs/decisions.md and a CHANGELOG.md entry record the root cause. The section informs the producer and refuses or holds nothing. On this round's send-back, the failing `retry` test target passes alone and the other checks pass.

open_issues: Root cause: the producer brief showed criteria but not how the verifier checks each one, and unmet_criteria trusts any criteria_check entry with status met. A 'met' with no evidence therefore passed until final verification. The stored check (Candidate.producer_report, pre_verdict_block) already existed, so it was not the gap. The fix informs the producer and adds no refusal or hold rule, so no refused-reading share applies.
The send-back from the earlier checks listed only the `retry` test target as failed. I found no code path in this change that affects it, and it passes when run alone.
I did not measure what share of failures the hint prevents. D191's Tradeoff says so.
learnings: `cargo test -p athena-cli --test retry` takes about 52s and can fail in a full workspace run under load; it passes alone. The failure did not reproduce.
The Bash hook in this environment allows only one plain cargo or git command per call. Pipes, grep, tail and command substitution are denied.
